items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Gus had a little guy, a trumpet player named Roy Fox, who was his lead trumpet player

ctx.x: Anybody of any name that you can remember was in those classes?

Oh, I can remember they had a bandleader around there named Rube Wolf, who was a trombone player -- he used to take lessons. A couple of guys that was in Gus Arnheim's band. Gus had a little guy, a trumpet player named Roy Fox, who was his lead trumpet player, and another saxophone player named Fats something. But he mostly taught theory and harmony, and stuff that I shouldn't have been in, that's what I'm saying, but that damn Papa Mutt talked me into going there. And Papa Mutt had the nutty idea that Doc…
What did Mutt think of his own playing? Did he ever talk about his own playing?
